title: Moonshot AI Empowers Scientific Research, DeepSeek Partners with Zhihu: China's Large AI Models Officially Launch Battle to Defend High-Quality Data and Professional Scenarios

content_html:
As the race to scale up large models' parameters gradually hits physical and cost ceilings, the industry faces an unavoidable pain point: general-purpose corpora are increasingly exhausted, and when models confront complex logic and domain-specific problems, they often fall into the hallucination trap of "sounding authoritative while talking nonsense." The marginal returns of generalization are diminishing. In the second half of AI, answers must come from the "deep end."

Recently, two moves by leading Chinese AI companies have clearly outlined a new path for large models to break through: a full shift from "generalized chit-chat" to "deep cultivation of specialized scenarios" and "building a high-quality data closed loop."

Moonshot AI officially announced the opening of the "Kimi Research Support Program," with its first phase specifically targeting researchers in the natural sciences, engineering, and related interdisciplinary fields. Selected participants will not only receive dedicated Kimi API credits, but also direct technical support from the Kimi team. This move directly addresses the core pain point of researchers: when faced with reviewing massive amounts of literature, debugging complex code, and integrating interdisciplinary knowledge, traditional tools are already showing signs of strain. Kimi's entry aims to upgrade large models from a marginal "assisted retrieval tool" to a "core research collaborator" deeply embedded in laboratory workflows, using computing power and algorithms to accelerate frontier scientific exploration.

Meanwhile, DeepSeek and Zhihu have officially formed a major content partnership. Through its open data platform, Zhihu will fully open to DeepSeek its retrieval capabilities for high-quality content accumulated over years, including community Q&A, in-depth articles, trending lists, and topic discussions. Even more noteworthy is the restraint and win-win nature of the collaboration mechanism: when Zhihu content is retrieved by DeepSeek and used to generate answers, the system will clearly display Zhihu source attribution, content summaries, and creator information, and provide a one-click link to read the original text.

This is by no means a simple "data purchase," but a landmark event marking the maturation of China's AI ecosystem. It means:

1. **High-quality data becomes a core moat**: Today, as low-quality internet text is being exhausted, structured knowledge communities like Zhihu—validated by human experts and possessing strong logic and depth—have become the "gold mine" for large models to break through professional cognition bottlenecks.
